summary: The team wants the deploy workflow to post release notes to the ticket when a deploy finishes, so people can see what went out without opening the CI logs.
Requested by the team lead; internal tooling work, no customer involvement.

acceptance_criteria: The deploy workflow (.github/workflows/agent-hub-deploy.yml) posts a release-notes comment on the ticket when a deploy to production succeeds.
The comment lists the commits deployed since the previous deploy.
Existing tests for the deploy workflow are updated to cover the new comment.
out_of_scope: Changes to the work order, implementation plan or build workflows.

codebase.relevance: The deploy workflow that runs after a merge.

getting_started: Read the files listed under the codebase section first.
